# Is the UK side-hustle tax limit £1,000 or £3,000?
URL: https://zcbm2373125333-hub.github.io/en/uk-trading-allowance-1000-vs-3000-threshold/
Language: en · Updated: 2026-10-29

Short answer: For tax year 2026/27 it is still £1,000 : if your gross side-hustle (trading) income is over £1,000 you must register for Self Assessment by 5 October after the tax year ends, and only £1,000 is tax-free. Budget 2026 (28 October 2026) confirmed that from 6 April 2027 (tax year 2027/28) the trading allowance itself rises to £3,000 , and the Self Assessment reporting threshold for trading income rises to £3,000 with it – so from 2027/28 gross trading income up to £3,000 is tax-free and need not be reported. It still needs to be legislated in Finance Bill 2026-27.


Worked example (illustrative): Illustrative only. Priya, employed, sells handmade candles on Etsy and at markets in tax year 2025/26 (6 April 2025 – 5 April 2026): gross takings £2,400 , materials and fees £300 . Step Option A: trading allowance Option B: actual expenses Gross income £2,400 £2,400 Deduct £1,000 allowance £300 expenses Taxable profit £1,400 £2,100 She picks the allowance (lower profit). Because gross income is over £1,000 she must register for Self Assessment by 5 October 2026 and file by 31 January 2027. Assuming her salary already uses her personal allowance and she is a basic-rate (20%) taxpayer, that is £280 income tax on £1,400; the profit is below the Class 4 NIC threshold. From 2027/28, the same £2,400 would fall under the new £3,000 trading allowance: no tax and no Self Assessment for this income (assuming nothing else puts her in Self Assessment). Separately: if Priya made 30+ sales or more than €2,000 (about £1,700) on Etsy, Etsy reports her to HMRC under the digital platform rules. That report is information, not a bill.
The three numbers people mix up: £1,000 ; Trading allowance: tax-free; also the gross level above which you register for Self Assessment ; In force until 5 April 2027 (since 6 April 2017) ; GOV.UK | £3,000 ; New trading allowance (tax-free) and Self Assessment reporting threshold for gross trading income ; Confirmed at Budget 2026 (28 Oct 2026); from 6 April 2027 (2027/28), via Finance Bill 2026-27 ; HMRC policy paper , HM Treasury 2025 | 30 sales / €2,000 (≈£1,700) ; Platform reporting: below both, a platform need not report a goods seller ; In force (reports each January since 2025) ; HMRC
What counts as trading income? Self-employment, casual services such as babysitting or gardening, and hiring out personal equipment ( GOV.UK ). Selling your own unwanted possessions, usually at a loss, is generally not trading – but buying to resell is. When you must register even under £1,000 To claim a loss, pay voluntary Class 2 NIC, or claim Tax-Free Childcare or Maternity Allowance based on self-employment ( GOV.UK ). StraightGate makes record-keeping tools, not tax advice. If in doubt, check with HMRC or an accountant.
FAQ:
Q: Is the first £3,000 of side-hustle income tax-free?
A: Not yet. Up to 5 April 2027 only £1,000 is tax-free. From 6 April 2027 (tax year 2027/28) Budget 2026 raises the trading allowance to £3,000, so the first £3,000 of gross trading income becomes tax-free.
Q: When does the £3,000 threshold start?
A: 6 April 2027, for tax year 2027/28 onwards – confirmed at Budget 2026 on 28 October 2026. For 2025/26 and 2026/27 the £1,000 rule still applies.
Q: Is the £1,000 per platform?
A: No. It is per person, across all your trades combined, per tax year.
Q: Will eBay or Vinted report me to HMRC?
A: Platforms report sellers who make 30 or more sales of goods or receive more than about £1,700 (€2,000) in a year. A report does not mean you owe tax.
Q: Can I use the allowance and deduct expenses?
A: No – it is one or the other. Use the £1,000 allowance when your real expenses are lower than £1,000.
Sources: GOV.UK / HMRC – Income Tax: increasing the trading allowance (policy paper, Budget 2026, 28 October 2026) <https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/income-tax-increasing-the-trading-allowance/increasing-the-trading-allowance>; GOV.UK – Tax-free allowances on property and trading income <https://www.gov.uk/guidance/tax-free-allowances-on-property-and-trading-income>; GOV.UK – Self Assessment: who must send a tax return <https://www.gov.uk/self-assessment-tax-returns/who-must-send-a-tax-return>; GOV.UK / HM Treasury – Boost for side-hustlers: reporting threshold to rise to £3,000 'within this parliament' (11 March 2025) <https://www.gov.uk/government/news/boost-for-side-hustlers-as-300000-people-to-be-taken-out-of-tax-returns-government-announces>; UK Parliament – Written statement HCWS607 (28 April 2025) <https://questions-statements.parliament.uk/written-statements/detail/2025-04-28/HCWS607>; GOV.UK / HMRC – Reporting rules for digital platforms <https://www.gov.uk/guidance/reporting-rules-for-digital-platforms>

# Me ha llegado un aviso de Wallapop o Vinted por DAC7 (o una carta de Hacienda): ¿qué hago en 2026?
URL: https://zcbm2373125333-hub.github.io/es/hacienda-carta-wallapop-vinted-2026-que-hacer/
Language: es · Updated: 2026-10-20

Short answer: Calma: el aviso significa que la plataforma va a comunicar tus ventas a la Agencia Tributaria (modelo 238) porque en ella llegaste a 30 ventas o superaste 2.000 € en el año; no es una sanción ni un impuesto . Solo pagas si vendiste algo por más de lo que te costó (ganancia patrimonial, base del ahorro) o si compras para revender de forma habitual; si Hacienda te pregunta, lo que te protege son los justificantes de compra.


Worked example (illustrative): Ejemplo ilustrativo. Marta vende en Vinted en 2026 36 artículos por 1.150 € ; Vinted le pide NIF y la comunicará antes del 31/01/2027. Ventas Coste original Resultado fiscal 34 prendas usadas, 890 € ≈ 2.400 € Pérdida por uso → no se computa, 0 € a declarar 2 pares de zapatillas de edición limitada, 260 € 110 € Ganancia patrimonial 150 € → base del ahorro Marta solo declara 150 € de ganancia, no 1.150 €. Sin los tickets de las zapatillas no podría demostrar los 110 € de coste.
Qué es oficial y qué es ruido (octubre 2026): «Hacienda controla a quien pasa 30 ventas / 2.000 €» ; La plataforma comunica a quien hace 30 ventas o más, o cobra más de 2.000 €, por plataforma y año ; AEAT DAC7 | «Tendrás que pagar impuestos» ; DAC7 no cambia tus obligaciones; tributa la ganancia, no la venta ; AEAT , Wallapop | «Las pérdidas no cuentan» ; Las pérdidas por el uso de bienes de consumo duradero no se computan ; AEAT, art. 33.5.b LIRPF | «Guarda los tickets 4 años» ; El derecho de Hacienda a liquidar prescribe a los 4 años ; LGT art. 66 | «Multa mínima de 300 € y bloqueo a los 60 días» ; Lo publica la prensa (merca2, 15/10/2026); no lo hemos encontrado como regla general en la AEAT. El bloqueo del monedero es una medida de la plataforma si no das tus datos ; merca2 , Wallapop
Qué hacer, en orden Completa en la app los datos que pide la plataforma (NIF, dirección, fecha de nacimiento); si no, puede limitar tu cuenta o monedero. Haz una lista de tus ventas del año con fecha, precio de venta y, si lo sabes, precio y fecha de compra. Separa ventas con pérdida (nada que declarar) de ventas con ganancia (declarar en la renta). Si compras para revender con regularidad, consulta a un asesor: puede ser actividad económica (IRPF e IVA). Más detalle: el límite DAC7 , declarar en la renta y qué datos se comunican . StraightGate hace plantillas para llevar registros, no asesoramiento fiscal. Ante dudas, consulta a la AEAT o a un asesor.
FAQ:
Q: ¿El aviso de Wallapop es una carta de Hacienda?
A: No. Es la plataforma avisándote de que va a comunicar tus datos (modelo 238). Una carta de la AEAT sería un requerimiento aparte, normalmente pidiendo justificantes.
Q: ¿Tengo que pagar el 19 % de todo lo que vendí?
A: No. Solo se grava la ganancia (precio de venta menos precio de compra) en la base del ahorro; las ventas con pérdida de cosas usadas no tributan.
Q: ¿Qué pasa si no tengo los tickets de compra?
A: Sirve cualquier prueba razonable del coste: correos de pedido, extractos bancarios, facturas. Empieza a guardarlos ya para lo que vendas a partir de ahora.
Q: ¿Se suman Wallapop, Vinted y eBay para los 30 / 2.000 €?
A: No, cada plataforma cuenta por separado. Para la renta, en cambio, se suman todas tus ganancias.
Q: ¿Va a cambiar el límite?
A: La Comisión Europea propuso en junio de 2026 quitar el límite de 30 ventas y subir el importe a 3.000 € desde 2028. Es solo una propuesta.
